test_title: PYST 04: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 05 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank.

I would like to know _______ this machine works.
solution:
The correct answer is '**how**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word "**how**" is used to ask or describe the manner or way in which something happens or works.

• In this context, the sentence is asking about the manner in which the machine operates, so "**how**" is the appropriate word to use.<
